independent_acceptance_check.scope: Independent recheck of P0056-01, the exact Proposition 8.5 quantifiers and boundary convention, its proof use of Lemma 8.6, the finite BCFW application, and the stated limited repair; not a reproof of all 130 pages.
independent_acceptance_check.disposition: Retain Minor for the unrestricted infinite-family formulation; no demonstrated failure of the finite BCFW triangulation application.
independent_acceptance_check.decisive_check: With identity on R, L=(0,1), a_j=1/2+1/(2j), S_j=(a_{j+1},a_j), each cell has compact closure and the endpoint sharing conditions hold under the explicit stratum-frontier convention. Their closed-cell union is (1/2,1], omitting 1/4 in int K. Per-cell finite strata do not make the global family finite.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Lemma 8.6 expressly requires a finite family, and the proof also needs the image union closed. The actual BCFW family has a finite combinatorial count. A contextual standing finiteness restriction would narrow the finding to scope clarification. The counterexample is not in that actual application.
